name: The thriller in four parts
hint: A threat, a chase, a twist and a reckoning against the clock, with the stakes rising in every part.

parts.title: The threat
chapters: Ordinary life
(ca 2 %) Show the main character, what they are good at and what they stand to lose, with a shadow of danger on page one.
The first sign
(ca 8 %) Something is wrong, and the main character is the only one who sees it. The inciting moment.
No one believes them
(ca 12 %) The attempt to get help fails, so they have to act on their own.
No way back
(ca 25 %) A choice or an event locks them into the chase. Going home is no longer possible.

parts.title: The chase
chapters: The trail
(ca 30 %) The main character takes the initiative and gets closer, but every answer raises a new question.
The opponent strikes back
(ca 38 %) The villain answers with a move that shows how dangerous they are and how far they will go.
The clock starts
(ca 45 %) A concrete deadline makes everything urgent, and the reader knows exactly when it will be too late.
The midpoint
(ca 50 %) The main character goes from hunted to hunter, or wins a victory that turns out to be false.

parts.title: The twist
chapters: Everything was wrong
(ca 58 %) A planted truth turns what the reader believed upside down, and the plan collapses.
It gets personal
(ca 66 %) The threat turns on what the main character loves most, and the stakes peak.
Alone
(ca 75 %) The ally betrays them or falls. The darkest point, with the least time left.
The last plan
(ca 82 %) The main character understands something about themselves or the villain and decides to strike.

parts.title: The reckoning
chapters: Against the clock
(ca 88 %) The plan goes into action and goes wrong. Everything is decided in little time, in short scenes.
Face to face
(ca 94 %) The main character confronts the villain and wins through their own skill and choice, not luck.
After
(ca 99 %) Briefly: what has changed, what it cost, and whether the threat is truly over.
